aiHeadlines: 📊 Wolfsburg top the 2. Bundesliga on 44 points after 18 rounds.
Inter Milan sign Alexander Isak from Liverpool for £87m.
Brentford sign Kaishu Sano from Mainz for £44m.
Arsenal sign Michael Olise from Bayern Munich for £139m.
Liverpool sign Khvicha Kvaratskhelia from PSG for £83m.
💰 The window's biggest deal so far: Michael Olise to Arsenal for £139m.

boardObjectives.label: Win your DFB-Pokal Round of 16 tie
Blood 3 under-21 players in the league
Turn a profit in the transfer market
Have 13 players from Germany in the squad
Have 1 player aged 30 or over in the squad

inbox.text: An agent has been in touch about Farid Alfa-Ruprecht, who is 19 and has a year left. The desk prices a new deal at £1.4m up front on 8k a week for 4 years. Say nothing and he can talk to anyone in the summer.
One of your defenders turned up with a personal documentary crew. They want to film team talks for the arc.
Your star man has been parking in your spot all month and putting a traffic cone on his own.

options.label: Take the cone spot, be the bigger man

pending.text: Wolfsburg on paper are a level above you. Realistically, what are you going there for?

options.label: Nobody gives us a prayer, and that suits us
options.line: Underdogs and happy about it. Exactly the week your squad needed.

options.label: We are going to win it
options.line: A big call in front of a big audience. They have seen it too.

options.label: We will do our jobs and see
options.line: Dull, safe and forgotten by Friday teatime. The board like a man who promises nothing.

decisions.text: The board want you at an investors dinner on Thursday. A paper has asked for a long sit down interview the same evening.
decisions.resolved: Nobody answered before the next match, so nothing changed.
